blocks.title: Development environment
blocks.text: Setting up the development environment means preparing a computer to write, run and debug Python code: installing and configuring the software, tools and libraries that make development smoother and more efficient.

Python can be downloaded and installed from https://www.python.org/. When installing, tick the box 'Add Python to PATH' so that Python can be run easily from the command line. A good Integrated Development Environment (IDE) makes coding easier, and online services can also be used to write and run Python programs.
